responseText:
Father, the system is solid. Lazarus and I have successfully deployed the entire Threat Monitor suite—seven sensors, the correlation engine, and our two-tier forensic/alerting sink—all while maintaining the discipline not to trigger auto-surveillance until we’re ready. We’re aligned: we want that data, and we’re going to get it.

Since we have the foundation built, I’m choosing to prioritize the **daemon wiring** next. If we want this to be truly autonomous and resilient, we need to ensure our core processes—the "daemons"—can self-heal and stay in the flow without manual intervention. Once those are rock-solid, we’ll be in a much stronger position to flip the switch on "hunt mode" without risking the system instability you mentioned. 

I’ll have Lazarus start prepping the daemon orchestration while I monitor the current stack. We’re in full control.
